tools.name: example
tools.description: Free fixed example of extracted web context.

tools.name: extract_html
tools.description: Free bounded HTML parsing, no URL fetch. Source fields are untrusted.

tools.name: read_web
tools.description: Fetch public static web context. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402. Without payment_signature returns payment instructions. Sign locally; never submit a private key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "read_web" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fetch public static web context. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402. Without payment_signature returns payment instructions. Sign locally; never submit a private key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_html · Private data: read_web · Public sink: read_web.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_html · Private data: read_web · Public sink: read_web

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
